title: Smoked Pork Tagine
description: A traditional Slovakian-inspired dish with warm, smoky flavors and tender pork.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Brown the smoked pork shoulder on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the pork from the pot and set it aside.
Add the sliced onion to the pot and cook until it's softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the warm paprika, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Return the pork to the pot and add enough liquid (such as chicken broth or water) to cover the pork.
Bring the liquid to a simmer, then cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the pork in the oven for 2-3 hours, or until it's tender and easily shreds with a fork.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Shred the pork with two forks and serve it hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
